# Original operating-to-pretax statement sources

These gzip files retain complete original selected primary HTML from the offline review corpus, compressed with mtime0. No table values, headings, units or source context were edited. Tests independently pin decompressed SHA-256 before parsing.

- MELI accession `0001099590-26-000006`: `meli-2025.html.gz`; 4,348,564 decompressed bytes; SHA-256 `57805abbd6d3b3a40e87e49529657b79f47986ac370e6f9a437eadc7ab72198d`.
- SE accession `0001140361-26-015366`: `se-2025.html.gz`; 5,641,014 decompressed bytes; SHA-256 `9474df67304ba388df96be05e3437b718755c2d18922440bbfb9de6f0e81f575`.

Original sources are `work/full-review-sources/<accession>/filing.html` in the review workspace. They are public SEC filing content, not model output. Ordinals in tests identify observed original/competing tables for adversarial controls; runtime selection contains no issuer/ordinal/value rule.
